title_sq: APARTAMENT 1+1 PER SHITJE NE KOMPLEKSIN MAGNET
description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje apartament 1+1 tek Kompleksi Magnet (Kontakt)
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje godine te re ndertim i vitit 2022 brenda ne kompleks.
Organizohet ne:
-Korridor ne hyrje
-Dhome gjumi
-Tualet
-Ballkon
Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar ne menyre bashkekohore.
Mjaft i pershtatshem per investim ose aktivitet AiR BnB por gjithashtu dhe per banim personal.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hiopotekor dhe mund te shitet dhe me kredi.
title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE MAGNET COMPLEX
description_en: We offer for sale a 1+1 apartment in the Magnet Complex (Contact) The apartment is located on the 0th floor of a new building built in 2022 inside the complex. It is organized in: - Entrance corridor - Bedroom - Toilet - Balcony The apartment is completely furnished in a contemporary way. Quite suitable for investment or AiR BnB activity but also for personal residence. The property has regular mortgage documentation and can be sold with credit.
